sentences.zh: 丙申，以中書舍人史館修撰、判館事劉溫叟為禮部侍郎，判館如故。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, Drafting Officer of the Secretariat, Compiler of the History Office, and Administrator of the Office Liu Wensou was made Vice Director of the Ministry of Rites; his administration of the office remained as before.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day Liu Wensou, Drafting Officer of the Secretariat, Compiler of the History Office, and Administrator of the Office, was made Vice Director of the Ministry of Rites; his administration of the office remained as before.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，相州節度使王進卒。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, Military Commissioner of Xiang Prefecture Wang Jin died.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day Wang Jin, Military Commissioner of Xiang, died.

sentences.zh: 八月壬申朔，以宣徽北院使吳延祚為右監門衛大將軍充職，以樞密院直學士、尚書右丞邊歸讜為尚書左丞充職。

translations.literal: On the first day of the eighth month, day renshen, Northern Court Palace Commissioner Wu Yanzuo was made Major General of the Right Gate Guard Command to fill the post; Direct Academician of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Right Vice Director of the Ministry of Personnel Bian Guidan was made Left Vice Director of the Ministry of Personnel to fill the post.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the eighth month, the renshen day, Wu Yanzuo, Northern Court Palace Commissioner, was made Major General of the Right Gate Guard Command to fill the post; Bian Guidan, Direct Academician of the Bureau of Military Affairs and Right Vice Director of the Ministry of Personnel, was made Left Vice Director of the Ministry of Personnel to fill the post.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，幸南莊，賜從臣射。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, the Emperor visited Nanzhuang and granted the accompanying officials archery.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day the emperor visited Nanzhuang and granted the accompanying officials an archery contest.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以吏部侍郎顏衎為工部尚書致仕。

translations.literal: On day yisi, Vice Director of the Ministry of Personnel Yan Kan was made Minister of Works and retired.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day Yan Kan, Vice Director of the Ministry of Personnel, was made Minister of Works and retired.

sentences.zh: 丙午，同州節度使孫方諫卒。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, Military Commissioner of Tong Prefecture Sun Fangjian died.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day Sun Fangjian, Military Commissioner of Tong, died.

sentences.zh: 己酉，前澤州刺史李彥崇責授右司禦副率。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, former Prefect of Ze Prefecture Li Yanchong was demoted and appointed Deputy Commandant of the Right Imperial Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day Li Yanchong, former Prefect of Ze, was demoted and appointed Deputy Commandant of the Right Imperial Guard.

sentences.zh: 高平之役，帝與賊軍相遇，即令彥崇領兵守江豬嶺，以遏寇之歸路，彥崇初見王師已卻，即時而退，及劉崇兵敗，果由茲嶺而遁，故有是責。

translations.literal: In the campaign at Gaoping, when the Emperor met the rebel army, he at once ordered Yanchong to lead troops to hold Jiangzhu Ridge and block the enemy's line of retreat. Yanchong, seeing at first that the imperial army had withdrawn, at once retreated as well; when Liu Chong's army was defeated, it did indeed flee by this ridge—therefore he received this punishment.
translations.idiomatic: During the Gaoping campaign, when the emperor met the rebel army, he at once ordered Yanchong to lead troops to hold Jiangzhu Ridge and block the enemy's retreat. Yanchong, seeing the imperial army withdraw at first, retreated at once; when Liu Chong's army was defeated, it fled by that very ridge—hence this punishment.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以金州防禦使王暉為同州留後。

translations.literal: On day renzi, Defender of Jin Prefecture Wang Hui was made Acting Commander of Tong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day Wang Hui, Defender of Jin, was made Acting Commander of Tong.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以吳越國內外都指揮使吳延福為寧國軍節度使、檢校太尉，從錢俶之請也。

translations.literal: On day guichou, Overall Commander-in-Chief of Wuyue Wu Yanfu was made Military Commissioner of the Ningguo Army and Honorary Grand Marshal, at Qian Chu's request.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day Wu Yanfu, Overall Commander-in-Chief of Wuyue, was made Military Commissioner of the Ningguo Army and Honorary Grand Marshal, at Qian Chu's request.

sentences.zh: 以太子少師宋彥筠為太子太師致仕。

translations.literal: Supervisor of the Heir Apparent Song Yanjun was made Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent and retired.
translations.idiomatic: Song Yanjun, Supervisor of the Heir Apparent, was made Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent and retired.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以兵部郎中兼太常博士尹拙為國子祭酒。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, Bureau Director of the Ministry of War concurrently Erudite of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Yin Zhuo was made Director of the National University.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day Yin Zhuo, Bureau Director of the Ministry of War concurrently Erudite of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, was made Director of the National University.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，皇姑故福慶長公主追封燕國大長公主，李重進之母也。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, the late Princess Fuchang, the Emperor's paternal aunt, was posthumously enfeoffed as Grand Princess of Yan; she was Li Chongjin's mother.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day the late Princess Fuchang, the emperor's paternal aunt, was posthumously enfeoffed as Grand Princess of Yan; she was Li Chongjin's mother.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以戶部郎中致仕景初為太僕卿致仕，宰臣範之父也。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, retired Bureau Director of the Ministry of Revenue Jing Chu was made Minister of Imperial Studs and retired; he was Chief Minister Fan's father.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day Jing Chu, retired Bureau Director of the Ministry of Revenue, was made Minister of Imperial Studs and retired; he was Chief Minister Fan's father.

sentences.zh: 己巳，宜停華州鎮國軍，依舊為郡。

translations.literal: On day jisi, it was ordered to abolish the Zhenguo Army at Hua Prefecture and restore it as a commandery as before.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day it was ordered to abolish the Zhenguo Army at Hua and restore the prefecture as a commandery as before.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以給事中劉悅、康澄並為右散騎常侍。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, Supervising Censor Liu Yue and Kang Cheng were both made Right Regular Attendant of the Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day Liu Yue, Supervising Censor, and Kang Cheng were both made Right Regular Attendant of the Cavalry.

sentences.zh: 辛未，以左散騎常侍裴巽為御史中丞，以御史中丞張煦為兵部侍郎，集賢殿學士、判院事司徒詡為吏部侍郎，以左散騎常侍薛沖乂為工部侍郎。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, Left Regular Attendant of the Cavalry Pei Xun was made Vice Censor-in-Chief; Vice Censor-in-Chief Zhang Xu was made Vice Director of the Ministry of War; Academician of the Jixian Hall and Administrator of the Academy Situ Xu was made Vice Director of the Ministry of Personnel; Left Regular Attendant of the Cavalry Xue Chongyi was made Vice Director of the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day Pei Xun, Left Regular Attendant of the Cavalry, was made Vice Censor-in-Chief; Zhang Xu, Vice Censor-in-Chief, Vice Director of the Ministry of War; Situ Xu, Academician of the Jixian Hall and Administrator of the Academy, Vice Director of the Ministry of Personnel; Xue Chongyi, Left Regular Attendant of the Cavalry, Vice Director of the Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 九月壬申朔，以東京舊宅為皇建禪院。

translations.literal: On the first day of the ninth month, day renshen, the old residence in the Eastern Capital was made the Huangjian Chan Monastery.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the ninth month, the renshen day, the old residence in the Eastern Capital was made the Huangjian Chan Monastery.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以武安軍節度副使、知潭州軍府事周行逢為鄂州節度使，知潭州軍府事，加檢校太尉。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, Deputy Military Commissioner of the Wu'an Army and Administrator of Tan Prefecture Zhou Xingfeng was made Military Commissioner of E Prefecture while continuing to administer Tan Prefecture, and additionally made Honorary Grand Marshal.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day Zhou Xingfeng, Deputy Military Commissioner of the Wu'an Army and Administrator of Tan, was made Military Commissioner of E while continuing to administer Tan, and additionally made Honorary Grand Marshal.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，右屯衛將軍薛訓除名，流沙門島，坐監雍兵倉，縱吏卒掊斂也。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, General of the Right Encampment Guard Xue Xun was stripped of rank and exiled to Shamen Island, for supervising the Yong military granary and allowing clerks and soldiers to extort.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu day Xue Xun, General of the Right Encampment Guard, was stripped of rank and exiled to Shamen Island for supervising the Yong military granary and allowing clerks and soldiers to extort.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以右僕射致仕韓昭裔、左僕射致仕楊凝式並為太子太保致仕，以太子太傅致仕李肅為太子太師致仕。

translations.literal: On day jihai, retired Right Vice Director Han Zhaoyi and retired Left Vice Director Yang Ningshi were both made Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent and retired; retired Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent Li Su was made Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent and retired.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day Han Zhaoyi, retired Right Vice Director, and Yang Ningshi, retired Left Vice Director, were both made Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent and retired; Li Su, retired Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent, was made Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent and retired.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，斬宋州巡檢供奉官、副都知竹奉璘於寧陵縣，坐盜掠商船不捕獲也。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, Patrol Inspector of Song Prefecture, Palace Attendant, and Deputy Supervisor Zhu Fenglin was beheaded at Ningling County, for plundering merchant ships while serving in that post.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day Zhu Fenglin, Patrol Inspector of Song, Palace Attendant, and Deputy Supervisor, was beheaded at Ningling County for plundering merchant ships while serving in that post.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲辰，左羽林大將軍孟漢卿賜死，坐監納厚取耗餘也。

translations.literal: On day jiachen in the tenth month of winter, Major General of the Left Forest Guard Meng Hanqing was granted death, for supervising tax collection and taking excessive surplus allowances.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen day in the tenth month of winter Meng Hanqing, Major General of the Left Forest Guard, was granted death for supervising tax collection and taking excessive surplus allowances.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以安州節度使李洪義為青州節度使，以貝州節度使王饒為相州節度使，以徐州節度使王晏為西京留守，以西京留守武行德為徐州節度使。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, Military Commissioner of An Prefecture Li Hongyi was made Military Commissioner of Qing Prefecture; Military Commissioner of Bei Prefecture Wang Rao was made Military Commissioner of Xiang Prefecture; Military Commissioner of Xu Prefecture Wang Yan was made Military Governor of the Western Capital; Military Governor of the Western Capital Wu Xingde was made Military Commissioner of Xu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day Li Hongyi, Military Commissioner of An, was made Military Commissioner of Qing; Wang Rao of Bei, Military Commissioner of Xiang; Wang Yan of Xu, Military Governor of the Western Capital; Wu Xingde, Military Governor of the Western Capital, Military Commissioner of Xu.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以龍捷左廂都指揮使、泗州防禦使韓令坤為洋州節度使，充侍衛馬軍都指揮使；

translations.literal: On day wushen, Commander of the Left Wing of the Dragon Swift Army and Defender of Si Prefecture Han Lingkun was made Military Commissioner of Yang Prefecture and appointed Commander of the Palace Guard cavalry;
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day Han Lingkun, Commander of the Left Wing of the Dragon Swift Army and Defender of Si, was made Military Commissioner of Yang and appointed Commander of the Palace Guard cavalry;

sentences.zh: 以虎捷右廂都指揮使、永州防禦使李繼勛為利州節度使，充侍衛步軍都指揮使。

translations.literal: Commander of the Right Wing of the Tiger Swift Army and Defender of Yong Prefecture Li Jixun was made Military Commissioner of Li Prefecture and appointed Commander of the Palace Guard infantry.
translations.idiomatic: Li Jixun, Commander of the Right Wing of the Tiger Swift Army and Defender of Yong, was made Military Commissioner of Li and appointed Commander of the Palace Guard infantry.

sentences.zh: 己酉，太子太保致仕楊凝式卒。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, retired Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent Yang Ningshi died.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day Yang Ningshi, retired Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent, died.

sentences.zh: 詔安、貝二州依舊為防禦州，其軍額並停。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that An and Bei Prefectures be restored as defensive prefectures as before, and their army designations were all abolished.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered that An and Bei be restored as defensive prefectures as before, and their army designations were all abolished.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以今上為永州防禦使，依前殿前都虞候。

translations.literal: On day renzi, the present sovereign was made Defender of Yong Prefecture, retaining his previous post as Front Palace Deputy Commander.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day the present sovereign was made Defender of Yong, retaining his previous post as Front Palace Deputy Commander.

sentences.zh: 戊午，監修國史李穀等上言曰：「竊以自古王者鹹建史官，君臣獻替之謀皆須備載，家國安危之道得以直書。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, Supervisor of the Compilation of National History Li Gu and others submitted a memorial stating: "We presume that since antiquity kings and lords have all established historiographers; the counsel offered between ruler and minister in bringing improvement must all be fully recorded, and the paths of state and family's safety and peril can thereby be recorded straightforwardly.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day Li Gu, Supervisor of the Compilation of National History, and others submitted a memorial stating, "We presume that since antiquity kings and lords have all established historiographers; the counsel exchanged between ruler and minister must all be fully recorded, so that the paths of state and family's safety and peril can be written plainly.

sentences.zh: 歷代已來，其名不一。

translations.literal: Through successive ages down to the present, the names have not been uniform.
translations.idiomatic: Through successive ages the names have not been uniform.

sentences.zh: 人君言動，則起居註創於累朝；

translations.literal: For the ruler's words and actions, the Diary of Activity and Repose was instituted across many dynasties;
translations.idiomatic: For a ruler's words and actions, the Diary of Activity and Repose was instituted across many dynasties;

sentences.zh: 輔相經綸，則時政記興於前代。

translations.literal: For the chancellor's statecraft, the Record of Current Administration arose in earlier ages.
translations.idiomatic: For a chancellor's statecraft, the Record of Current Administration arose in earlier ages.

sentences.zh: 然後采其事實，編作史書。

translations.literal: Only then were facts gathered and historical works compiled.
translations.idiomatic: Only then were facts gathered and compiled into historical works.

sentences.zh: 蓋緣聞見之間須有來處，記錄之際得以審詳。

translations.literal: This was because between what was heard and seen there had to be a source, and at the time of recording one could be thorough and precise.
translations.idiomatic: This was because what was heard and seen had to have a source, and recording could then be thorough and precise.

sentences.zh: 今之左右起居郎，即古之左右史也。

translations.literal: The present Left and Right Attendants for the Diary of Activity and Repose are the ancient Left and Right Scribes.
translations.idiomatic: Today's Left and Right Attendants for the Diary of Activity and Repose are the ancient Left and Right Scribes.

sentences.zh: 唐文宗朝，命其官執筆，立於殿階螭頭之下，以紀政事。

translations.literal: In the reign of Tang Emperor Wenzong, these officials were ordered to hold the brush and stand below the ch'i-head of the palace steps to record affairs of state.
translations.idiomatic: Under Tang Emperor Wenzong, these officials were ordered to hold the brush and stand below the ch'i-head of the palace steps to record affairs of state.

sentences.zh: 後則明宗朝，命端明殿及樞密直學士，皆輪修日曆，旋送史官，以備纂修。

translations.literal: Later, in the reign of Emperor Mingzong, Direct Academicians of the Duanming Hall and the Bureau of Military Affairs were all in rotation to compile the daily calendar and promptly send it to the historiographers to prepare for compilation.
translations.idiomatic: Later, under Emperor Mingzong, Direct Academicians of the Duanming Hall and the Bureau of Military Affairs took turns compiling the daily calendar and promptly sending it to the historiographers for compilation.

sentences.zh: 及近朝，此事皆廢，史官惟憑百司報狀，館司但取兩省制書，此外雖有訪聞，例非端的。

translations.literal: In recent courts this practice has all been abandoned; historiographers rely only on reports from the hundred offices, and the archive office takes only edicts from the two secretariats—beyond this, though there may be inquiries and hearsay, as a rule it is not reliable.
translations.idiomatic: In recent courts this practice has been abandoned; historiographers rely only on reports from the hundred offices, and the archive office takes only edicts from the two secretariats. Beyond that, though there may be inquiries and hearsay, as a rule it is not reliable.

sentences.zh: 伏自先皇帝創開昌運，及皇帝陛下纘嗣丕基，其聖德武功、神謀睿略，而皆萬幾宥密，丹禁深嚴，非外臣之所知，豈庶僚之可訪。

translations.literal: Humbly, since the late emperor opened a splendid destiny and Your Majesty succeeded to the great foundation, his sagely virtue and martial achievement, divine stratagems and wise designs—all are matters of myriad affairs conducted in the inner sanctum, the crimson forbidden precinct deeply strict; they are not what outer ministers can know—how could lesser officials be consulted?
translations.idiomatic: Humbly, since the late emperor opened a splendid destiny and Your Majesty succeeded to the great foundation, his sagely virtue and martial achievement, divine stratagems and wise designs—all are matters of myriad affairs conducted in the inner sanctum, the forbidden precinct deeply strict. They are not what outer ministers can know—how could lesser officials be consulted?

sentences.zh: 此後欲望以諮詢之事、裁制之規，別命近臣旋具抄錄，每當修撰日曆，即令封付史臣，庶國事無漏略之文，職業免疏遺之咎。

translations.literal: Hereafter we wish that matters of consultation and rules of decision may be separately ordered to nearby ministers to copy down promptly; whenever the daily calendar is compiled, have these sealed and delivered to the historiographers, so that state affairs may lack no omitted passages and the profession may escape the fault of negligence.
translations.idiomatic: Hereafter we wish that matters of consultation and rules of decision may be separately assigned to nearby ministers to copy down promptly; whenever the daily calendar is compiled, have these sealed and delivered to the historiographers, so that state affairs may lack no omitted passages and our office may escape the fault of negligence.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " The request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: " His request was granted.

sentences.zh: 因命樞密直學士，起今後於樞密使處，逐月抄錄事件，送付史館。

translations.literal: Thereupon Direct Academicians of the Bureau of Military Affairs were ordered that from now on, at the Commissioner of Military Affairs' office, they should each month copy down events and send them to the History Office.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Direct Academicians of the Bureau of Military Affairs were ordered that from then on, at the Commissioner of Military Affairs' office, they should each month copy down events and send them to the History Office.

sentences.zh: 己未，供奉官郝光庭棄市，坐在葉縣巡檢日，挾私斷殺平人也。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, Palace Attendant Hao Guangting was executed in the marketplace, for during his days as patrol inspector in Ye County he killed a commoner in a private vendetta.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei day Hao Guangting, Palace Attendant, was executed in the marketplace for killing a commoner in a private vendetta while serving as patrol inspector in Ye County.

sentences.zh: 是日大閱，帝親臨之。

translations.literal: That day a grand review was held, and the Emperor personally attended.
translations.idiomatic: That day a grand review was held, and the emperor personally attended.

sentences.zh: 帝自高平之役，睹諸軍未甚嚴整，遂有退卻，至是命今上一概簡閱，選武藝超絕者，署為殿前諸班，因是有散員、散指揮使、內殿直、散都頭、鐵騎、控鶴之號。

translations.literal: Since the campaign at Gaoping, the Emperor had seen that the armies were not very disciplined and there had been retreats; at this time he ordered the present sovereign to review them all comprehensively, selecting those of surpassing martial skill and appointing them to the various Front Palace companies—hence the designations Irregular Attendants, Irregular Commanders, Inner Hall Direct, Irregular Squad Chiefs, Iron Cavalry, and Cranes Controlling.
translations.idiomatic: Since the Gaoping campaign, the emperor had seen that the armies were not very disciplined and had retreated; at this time he ordered the present sovereign to review them comprehensively, selecting those of surpassing martial skill and appointing them to the various Front Palace companies—hence the designations Irregular Attendants, Irregular Commanders, Inner Hall Direct, Irregular Squad Chiefs, Iron Cavalry, and Cranes Controlling.

sentences.zh: 復命總戎者，自龍捷、虎捷以降，一一選之，老弱羸小者去之，諸軍士伍，無不精當。

translations.literal: He also ordered the commanders-in-chief, from the Dragon Swift and Tiger Swift armies downward, to select one by one, removing the old, weak, and frail; among all army ranks and files, none were not fit and proper.
translations.idiomatic: He also ordered the commanders-in-chief, from the Dragon Swift and Tiger Swift armies downward, to select one by one and remove the old, weak, and frail, until every rank and file in the armies was fit and proper.

sentences.zh: 由是兵甲之盛，近代無比，且減冗食之費焉。

translations.literal: Hence the flourishing of arms and armor was unmatched in recent times, and moreover superfluous consumption was reduced.
translations.idiomatic: Hence the army's strength was unmatched in recent times, and superfluous consumption was reduced as well.

translations.literal: (Editorial note:
translations.idiomatic: [Note:

sentences.zh: （《五代會要》：顯德元年，上謂侍臣曰：「侍衛兵士老少相半，強懦不分，蓋徇人情，不能選練。

translations.literal: (From the 《Institutional Essentials of the Five Dynasties》: In the first year of Xiande, the Emperor said to attending ministers: "Palace guard soldiers are half old and half young, strong and weak undifferentiated—presumably indulging human sentiment, unable to select and drill.
translations.idiomatic: (From the 《Institutional Essentials of the Five Dynasties》: In the first year of Xiande, the emperor said to attending ministers, "Palace guard soldiers are half old and half young, strong and weak undifferentiated—presumably indulging human sentiment, unable to select and drill.

sentences.zh: 今春朕在高平，與劉崇及蕃軍相遇，臨敵有指使不前者，茍非朕親當堅陣，幾至喪敗。

translations.literal: This spring I was at Gaoping and met Liu Chong and the barbarian army; facing the enemy there were commanders who would not advance—had I not personally held the firm line, we would nearly have suffered defeat.
translations.idiomatic: This spring I was at Gaoping and met Liu Chong and the barbarian army. Facing the enemy, some commanders would not advance—had I not personally held the firm line, we would nearly have suffered defeat.

sentences.zh: 況百戶農夫，未能贍一甲士，且兵在精不在眾，宜令一一點選，精銳者升在上軍，怯懦者任從安便，庶期可用，又不虛費。

translations.literal: Moreover, a hundred farming households cannot support one armored soldier; troops lie in quality, not numbers. It is fitting to have them selected one by one—the elite promoted to the upper army, the timid allowed to take convenient posts, so that we may expect usefulness and not waste resources in vain.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, a hundred farming households cannot support one armored soldier; troops lie in quality, not numbers. They should be selected one by one—the elite promoted to the upper army, the timid allowed to take convenient posts, so that we may expect usefulness and not waste resources in vain.

sentences.zh: 」先是，上按於高平，觀其退縮，慨然有懲革之志。

translations.literal: " Earlier, when the Emperor reviewed troops at Gaoping and saw their withdrawal, he sighed with resolve to reform and punish.
translations.idiomatic: " Earlier, when the emperor reviewed troops at Gaoping and saw them withdraw, he resolved to reform and punish.

sentences.zh: 又以驍勇之士，多為外諸侯所占，如是召募天下豪傑，不以草澤為阻，在於闕下，躬親試閱，選武藝超絕及有身首者，分署為殿前諸班。）〉

translations.literal: Also, because valiant warriors were largely taken by outer feudatories, he thus recruited heroes throughout the realm, not hindered by obscurity; at the capital he personally tested and reviewed them, selecting those of surpassing martial skill and stature and assigning them to the various Front Palace companies.)〉
translations.idiomatic: Also, because valiant warriors were largely taken by outer feudatories, he recruited heroes throughout the realm without regard to humble origins; at the capital he personally tested and reviewed them, selecting those of surpassing martial skill and stature and assigning them to the various Front Palace companies.)]

sentences.zh: 十一月戊寅，以太子賓客石光贊為兵部尚書致仕。

translations.literal: On day wuyin in the eleventh month, Guest of the Heir Apparent Shi Guangzan was made Minister of War and retired.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day in the eleventh month Shi Guangzan, Guest of the Heir Apparent, was made Minister of War and retired.

sentences.zh: 壬午，鎮州節度使曹英卒。

translations.literal: On day renwu, Military Commissioner of Zhen Prefecture Cao Ying died.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day Cao Ying, Military Commissioner of Zhen, died.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以澶州節度使郭崇為鎮州節度使。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, Military Commissioner of Cao Prefecture Guo Chong was made Military Commissioner of Zhen Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day Guo Chong, Military Commissioner of Cao, was made Military Commissioner of Zhen.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以荊南節度副使、歸州刺史高保勖為寧江軍節度使、檢校太尉，充荊南節度行軍司馬。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, Deputy Military Commissioner of Jingnan and Prefect of Gui Prefecture Gao Baoxu was made Military Commissioner of the Ningjiang Army and Honorary Grand Marshal, and appointed Acting Chief Administrator of Jingnan.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day Gao Baoxu, Deputy Military Commissioner of Jingnan and Prefect of Gui, was made Military Commissioner of the Ningjiang Army and Honorary Grand Marshal, and appointed Acting Chief Administrator of Jingnan.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，詔宰臣李穀監築河堤。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, an edict ordered Chief Minister Li Gu to supervise construction of the river embankment.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day an edict ordered Chief Minister Li Gu to supervise construction of the river embankment.

sentences.zh: 先是，鄆州界河決，數州之地洪流為患，故命穀治之。

translations.literal: Earlier, the Yellow River had burst its banks in the border of Yun Prefecture, and several prefectures suffered from flooding—therefore Gu was ordered to remedy it.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier the Yellow River had burst its banks in the border of Yun, and several prefectures suffered from flooding—therefore Gu was ordered to remedy it.

sentences.zh: 役丁夫六萬人，三十日而罷。

translations.literal: Sixty thousand corvée laborers were employed, and the work was completed in thirty days.
translations.idiomatic: Sixty thousand corvée laborers were mobilized, and the work was finished in thirty days.

sentences.zh: 十二月己酉，太子太師侯益以本官致仕。

translations.literal: On day jiyou in the twelfth month, Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent Hou Yi retired in his present office.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiyou day in the twelfth month Hou Yi, Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent, retired in his present office.
